part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 78% chance that the U.S. Commerce Department will officially expand export licensing requirements to include all foreign cloud providers operating outside allied jurisdictions before February 8, 2028.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Commerce Department Bureau of Industry and Security
resolution_criteria.metric: Official publication of expanded export licensing rule covering foreign cloud providers
resolution_criteria.threshold: Published in the Federal Register or official agency notices

baseline.value: 0 foreign cloud providers globally mandated under comprehensive BIS Affiliates Rule tier outside allied jurisdictions

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: official Federal Register export control rule notices; status: formally enacted and published; window: between August 9, 2026 and February 8, 2028; excludes: draft notices, unadopted interagency proposals, or non-binding guidance letters.

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 65% chance that the European Commission will formally issue anti-coercion trade retaliatory tariffs against American cloud computing services before August 9, 2029.

resolution_criteria.source: Official Journal of the European Union
resolution_criteria.metric: Adoption and publication of an Implementing Regulation under the EU Anti-Coercion Instrument targeting digital services
resolution_criteria.threshold: Formal enactment of retaliatory trade measures

baseline.value: 0 EU anti-coercion trade retaliatory measures active against American cloud services

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: published EU Implementing Regulations; status: legally binding in force; window: between August 9, 2026 and August 9, 2029; excludes: parliamentary draft motions, non-binding resolutions, or preliminary investigative reports.

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 82% chance that the U.S. International Trade Commission will formally initiate a Section 337 investigation into foreign semiconductor packaging intellectual property theft before August 9, 2030.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. International Trade Commission Notice of Investigation
resolution_criteria.metric: Formal publication of a notice of investigation in the Federal Register under Section 337
resolution_criteria.threshold: Notice published initiating an active investigation

baseline.value: 0 active Section 337 investigations specific to advanced foreign semiconductor packaging IP

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: published Federal Register notices of investigation; status: officially instituted; window: between August 9, 2026 and August 9, 2030; excludes: private industry petitions, dismissed complaints, or preliminary fact-finding surveys.

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 70% chance that the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking will formally announce an expansion of operational AI Factories exceeding thirty units before August 9, 2031.

resolution_criteria.source: EuroHPC Joint Undertaking Official Press Releases and Governing Board Decisions
resolution_criteria.metric: Total number of officially operational EuroHPC AI Factories deployed across member states
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: operational AI Factory sites; status: officially inaugurated and functioning; window: between August 9, 2026 and August 9, 2031; excludes: planned funding allocations, construction-phase facilities, or unapproved candidate sites.
